dialogueEntries.text: Ella was right, the place was not far. You all bought boba, but there's an air of awkward tension resting between you.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: So... how was your summer?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Fine. How was yours?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: It was good! Ella and I went to the beach together.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Dina, no offense, but I think you're going to bore her with all that small talk.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: Right. Sorry.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: So, about this morning...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: It's really fine, Ella. We don't have to talk about it.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: It didn't seem fine to me, Ayla. We've been friends for years and I haven't ever seen you like that.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: For years, huh?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Were we not?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Were we not?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Are any of you actually yourselves?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: ...What?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: I mean, first my dad comes back to life. Something that is TOTALLY normal.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: And now it seems like everyone's trying to suck up to me. What's with that?
Ella and Dina still look confused.
Ella and Dina still look confused.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: This is what I mean. You're both doing it right now.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Everyone keeps adhering to me. My wishes, my feelings. If I act like any of you did something wrong, you grovel at my feet begging for forgiveness.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: What is this, really? What kind of trick is this?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: All we wanted to do was make you happy, Ayla. Are we not making you happy?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: All we wanted to do was make you happy, Ayla. Are we not making you happy?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: No. What are you all, some marionettes for someone... something else?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: This doesn't make me happy. Nothing here is making me happy.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: ...Are you sure about that, Ayla?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: What?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Admit it. It's better for you here. You do feel happier here. Isn't that all that matters?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: No, that's-

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: We need to stop talking about this. She's angry.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: We need to stop talking about this. She's angry.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: What? Who is she?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Ayla, drop it.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Ayla, drop it.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: I can't do that until you give me answers. What do you mean?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Ayla... it's...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: What?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: ..it's too late. She's here.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Wh-

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: So, what are you planning to do for Homecoming?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: ...what were we just talking about?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: She said what are you planning to do for Homecoming! Jeez, you need to stop zoning out, silly.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Homecoming? I- I don't have any plans.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: You should come with us! We're planning on going dress shopping next week.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: And we also wanted to go to a restaurant before the dance.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Yeah... yeah, that'd be nice.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: Please choose something not too heavy. I gained like, 5 pounds RIGHT before the 8th grade dance.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: And whose fault is that? You're the one who decided to order that much!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: It was yours! You tempted me by picking Mexican Food!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: You ordered the Mega Mountain Taco Plate. I don't know what you were expecting, Dina.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: Because the place you chose was too tempting!
They continue to talk about simple things. Your mind is fuzzy, like you can't remember something important.
Right. Dad's still waiting for you at home.
But for now, you're content to listen to Ella and Dina bicker.
Hanging out like this, it's nice. You missed it.
Eventually, the time comes to go home.
Eventually, the time comes to go home.
